scopes.fixed_K: frozen nominal sequence, u=v+K(x-z); nominal terminal z3=0
scopes.held_native: first native N3 predicted plan held for three steps, matched to fixed_K reference
scopes.receding_native: three executed receding steps; distinct prefix/tail and terminal semantics
scopes.comparison: no bound ordering between M0 and fixed_K policy classes; no general causal optimum

costs.offline_Z_terminal: exact nilpotent construction and nominal terminal {0}; previous pilot composite cost retained separately; standalone timings unavailable
costs.checker: saved independent exact replay intervals; construction/checking are not native solve time
